translations.web: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.
translations.bsb: “Leave her alone,” Jesus replied. “She has kept this perfume in preparation for the day of My burial.
translations.kjv: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
